# Install

Pick your language. Every package has the same API; only the naming follows each language's
conventions (see [Compatibility](compatibility.md) for runtime versions).

=== "TypeScript"

    Node.js 22.12 or newer (ESM and CommonJS).

    ```sh
    npm install @grow-codes/infisical
    ```

    Optional peer dependencies are only needed for the adapters you use (for example `pino`,
    `winston`, `express`, `fastify`).

=== "Rust"

    Rust 1.88 or newer (edition 2021), tokio runtime.

    ```sh
    cargo add grow-infisical
    cargo add tokio --features macros,rt-multi-thread
    ```

    Cargo features:

    - `blocking` — synchronous `blocking::InfisicalClient`
    - `testing` — in-memory fakes and the conformance runner

=== "Go"

    Go 1.26 or newer. The module lives in the `go/` folder of the repository; the package name
    is `infisical`.

    ```sh
    go get github.com/grow-codes-packages/infisical/go@latest
    ```

    ```go
    import infisical "github.com/grow-codes-packages/infisical/go"
    ```

=== "Python"

    Python 3.10 or newer.

    ```sh
    pip install grow-infisical
    ```

    Extras add optional integrations, for example `pip install "grow-infisical[all]"`.

=== "Java"

    Java 17 or newer.

    ```xml
    <dependency>
      <groupId>codes.grow.packages</groupId>
      <artifactId>infisical</artifactId>
      <version>0.1.0</version>
    </dependency>
    ```

    Gradle: `implementation("codes.grow.packages:infisical:0.1.0")`.

## Verify the installation

Run the [Quickstart](quickstart.md) against a running Infisical. To start one locally with the
same image the tests use:

```sh
docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 infisical/infisical:v0.167.10
```

The service may need extra settings to start (see `docker/compose.yml` in the repository).

## Versions

Packages follow [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org). Before 1.0, minor versions may contain
breaking changes; they are listed in each package's `CHANGELOG.md`. The five packages are released
together from one release pull request, so the same version number means the same API.
